items.question: What does reflection symmetry mean?
items.expected_answer: A line divides a figure into matching mirror halves.
reasoning_points: Imagine folding along the symmetry line.

items.question: What is a quarter turn?
reasoning_points: A full turn has four equal quarter turns.

items.question: A design matches itself after every quarter turn. What order of rotational symmetry?
A design has both mirror symmetry and rotational symmetry. How is it classified?
items.expected_answer: It has both types of symmetry.
reasoning_points: Test reflection and then rotation separately.

items.question: Why can repeating a block four times create rotationally related designs?
items.expected_answer: Each placement can be related by repeated turns around a centre.
reasoning_points: Observe the repeated orientation of the block.

items.question: How can you test a letter for rotational symmetry?
items.expected_answer: Rotate the cut-out about a fixed centre and check whether it matches before a full turn.
reasoning_points: Keep the centre fixed while turning.
